summary.reason: Scenario 2 adds meaningful Agent UX findings over Scenario 1 while avoiding the heavy duplication and lower score per agent of Scenario 3.
summary.strongestFinding: reset-confirmation accepts mockup:pending_approval but does not clearly revert that state to mockup:questions_pending, leaving plan answer blocked and stale mockups potentially approvable.

scenario-1.title: pending_approval stale artifact can bypass submitMockup validation and proceed to approval
answer sample risks double-wrapped CLI JSON
readJsonOrThrow instruction could break tolerant plan list behavior
questions lacks consistent read or lock requirement

scenario-2.title: reset-confirmation pending_approval rollback and stale approval risk
CLI contract tests need isolated temp workspaces and cwd restoration
CLI JSON shape is ambiguous between manager raw data and CLI wrapper
numbered choices can save literal numeric input instead of option value
optional assets lacks durable declined state
Section 2 mockup generation prohibition can conflict with Section 3 after confirmation
missing plan reported as GSDC_JSON_PARSE_ERROR gives poor recovery guidance

scenario-3.title: reset-confirmation pending_approval rollback gap blocks editing
pending_approval stale artifact can still be approved without artifact/hash recheck
readJsonOrThrow should not mechanically change tolerant plan list behavior
answer operation order should read plan.json before validating state
optional assets lacks durable declined state
requiredPendingCount rendering condition can skip optional assets
answer response shape risks double CLI wrapping
CLI tests should assert status, stdout, stderr, and error JSON
